svg.title: Repository map: sources, record, generated outputs
svg.desc: Repository map. Code: mechanical/, electrical/, sim-model/. Record folders: 00 assessment, 01 management, 02 concept, 03 system, 04 hardware, 05 software, 06 validation, 07 supporting, 08 analyses, 09 operation, 10 safety-case, process/ model, trace/ items, case/ records. Generated: README figures and status card, Living Safety Case dashboard, Process maps, swimlanes, gate skeletons, Folder indexes, Decision inbox page, GitHub wiki.

svg.text: A passing run accepts nothing on its own: a claim is accepted only by a recorded review.

svg.text: Source changes land under the change process; the record changes in the same pull request; every figure, map and page is regenerated from it.
